result.summary: The environment is a narrow residential street with continuous row housing and on-street parking on both sides. While the narrow street width naturally moderates vehicle speeds, the lack of marked crossings and visual obstructions from parked cars create risks for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: No designated crossing points are visible, which may lead to unpredictable pedestrian movements and lack of driver awareness.

hazards.name: Sight line obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along both curbs obstruct the view between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in the travel lane.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at intersections to clearly define pedestrian space and priority.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement bulb-outs at intersections to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility by moving pedestrians past parked cars before they enter the travel lane.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near intersections to ensure clear sight lines for pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: A narrow residential street lined with row houses and dense on-street parking. The sidewalk is present but narrow, with building steps encroaching on the walking path and parked vehicles obstructing sightlines.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Large vehicles parked along the curb block the view of the roadway for pedestrians attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line in the foreground and midground.

hazards.name: Narrow Sidewalk with Obstructions
hazards.description: The sidewalk is narrow and further constrained by steps leading to house entrances, limiting space for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, adjacent to the row houses.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near the ends of the block to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at intersections to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Install street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and the roadway.

result.summary: This is a residential intersection featuring marked zebra crosswalks and a stop-controlled approach for vehicles. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the environment is constrained by narrow walkways and limited sightlines due to buildings situated at the property line.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk paint is worn and faded, reducing its visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the intersection

hazards.name: Blind Corner Sightlines
hazards.description: The brick building on the left is built to the edge of the sidewalk, potentially obscuring pedestrians from drivers approaching the stop sign.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground at the corner of the brick building

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Repainting
interventions.description: Refresh the zebra markings with high-visibility thermoplastic to ensure the crossing is clearly visible to drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with a marked zebra crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, sightlines are partially obstructed by parked vehicles near the crossing point.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection and crosswalk obscure the sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb near the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and prevent illegal parking near the crosswalk.
